poincare-1902.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1902.locus: Bibliothèque de Philosophie scientifique, pp. 1–284 (Introduction & Parts I–IV, Chs. I–XIII)
poincare-1902.note: Primary French public-domain witness. Synthesizes Poincaré's foundational essays from 1891–1901 into a unified treatise on arithmetic induction, the continuum, non-Euclidean geometries, conventionalism, classical mechanics, and electrodynamics; later Flammarion printings include the section 'Les Géométries de Hilbert' (pp. 63–64).

poincare-1905-greenstreet.author: Henri Poincaré (trans. W. J. Greenstreet, preface by J. Larmor)
poincare-1905-greenstreet.publisher: Walter Scott Publishing Co., Ltd., London and Newcastle-on-Tyne
poincare-1905-greenstreet.note: Authorized British public-domain English translation, collated in this codex against the 1902 Flammarion French edition and Halsted's 1905 American translation.

poincare-1905-halsted.author: Henri Poincaré (trans. George Bruce Halsted, special preface by H. Poincaré, intro. by Josiah Royce)
poincare-1905-halsted.work: Science and Hypothesis (reprinted in The Foundations of Science, 1913)
poincare-1905-halsted.publisher: The Science Press, New York and Garrison, N.Y.
poincare-1905-halsted.note: Authorized American public-domain translation preserving strict non-Euclidean terminology ('Bolyai and Lobachevski', 'reasoning by recurrence') and Poincaré's special English preface clarifying the limits of convention in science.

poincare-1882.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1882.note: Memoir introducing the conformal hyperbolic disk and upper half-plane models, orthogonal-circle geodesics, and Fuchsian automorphic tessellations.

poincare-1891.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1891.locus: Revue générale des sciences pures et appliquées, Vol. 2, pp. 769–774
poincare-1891.note: Original essay introducing the Lobachevsky–Euclidean Translation Dictionary and the conventionalism thesis ('Les axiomes géométriques ne sont donc ni des jugements synthétiques a priori ni des faits expérimentaux. Ce sont des conventions').

poincare-1894.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1894.work: Sur la nature du raisonnement mathématique
poincare-1894.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, Vol. 2, pp. 371–384
poincare-1894.note: Foundational paper defending complete mathematical induction (reasoning by recurrence) as the paradigmatic synthetic a priori judgment of pure mathematics (expanded into Ch. I of La Science et l'Hypothèse).

poincare-1895-espace.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1895-espace.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, Vol. 3, pp. 631–646
poincare-1895-espace.note: Introduces the distinction between perceptual/motor space and geometric space along with the Heated-Disk optical world (expanded into Ch. IV of La Science et l'Hypothèse).

poincare-1899-russell.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1899-russell.work: Des fondements de la géométrie : à propos d'un livre de M. Russell
poincare-1899-russell.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, Vol. 7, pp. 251–279
poincare-1899-russell.note: Poincaré's incisive review of Bertrand Russell's 1897 Essay on the Foundations of Geometry, challenging Russell's claim that projective geometry is wholly a priori and demanding an operational criterion of spatial congruence.

russell-1897.author: Bertrand Russell
russell-1897.work: An Essay on the Foundations of Geometry
russell-1897.note: Russell's neo-Kantian treatise arguing that projective geometry expresses the a priori form of externality while constant-curvature metrical axioms encompass empirical elements (digitized in geometor/bertrand-russell).

russell-1899-reponse.author: Bertrand Russell
russell-1899-reponse.work: Sur les axiomes de la géométrie
russell-1899-reponse.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, Vol. 7, pp. 684–707
russell-1899-reponse.note: Russell's French reply to Poincaré defending the irreducibility of absolute distance and spatial relations against Poincaré's group-theoretic conventionalism.

poincare-1900-replique.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1900-replique.work: Sur les principes de la géométrie : réponse à M. Russell
poincare-1900-replique.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, Vol. 8, pp. 73–86
poincare-1900-replique.note: Poincaré's rejoinder to Russell on disguised definitions, solid-body displacements, and the meaninglessness of absolute spatial scale.

poincare-1902-hilbert.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare-1902-hilbert.work: Les fondements de la géométrie (Review of D. Hilbert, Grundlagen der Geometrie)
poincare-1902-hilbert.locus: Bulletin des Sciences Mathématiques, 2e série, Vol. 26, pp. 249–272
poincare-1902-hilbert.note: Detailed technical review of Hilbert's 1899 Grundlagen, directly informing the 'Les Géométries de Hilbert' section in Flammarion printings of La Science et l'Hypothèse.

hilbert-1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert-1899.work: Grundlagen der Geometrie (Festschrift zur Feier der Enthüllung des Gauss-Weber-Denkmals in Göttingen)
hilbert-1899.note: Formal axiomatization of Euclidean geometry and construction of non-Archimedean and non-Pascalian geometries (bilingual codex in geometor/hilbert).

hoenen-1954.author: Petrus Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen-1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen-1954.note: Systematic epistemological critique of Poincaré's conventionalism and Hilbert's formalism grounded in Aristotelian–Thomistic intelligible matter and intellectual nexus judgment (bilingual codex in geometor/hoenen).

lobachevsky-1840.author: Nikolai Ivanovich Lobachevsky
lobachevsky-1840.work: Geometrische Untersuchungen zur Theorie der Parallellinien
lobachevsky-1840.note: Concise German exposition of hyperbolic geometry (translated into English by G. B. Halsted, 1891).

bolyai-1832.author: János Bolyai
bolyai-1832.work: Appendix scientiam spatii absolute veram exhibens
bolyai-1832.locus: Supplement to Farkas Bolyai, Tentamen juventutem studiosam in elementa matheseos purae introducendi, 26 pp.
bolyai-1832.note: Independent creation of absolute and hyperbolic geometry.

riemann-1867.author: Bernhard Riemann
riemann-1867.work: Über die Hypothesen, welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen
riemann-1867.locus: Abhandlungen der Königlichen Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, Vol. 13, pp. 133–152
riemann-1867.note: Establishes Riemannian manifolds, metric tensors, and constant-positive-curvature geometry.

beltrami-1868.author: Eugenio Beltrami
beltrami-1868.work: Saggio di interpretazione della geometria non-euclidea
beltrami-1868.note: First projective disk and pseudospherical models demonstrating the relative consistency of Lobachevsky's plane geometry.

klein-1872.author: Felix Klein
klein-1872.work: Vergleichende Betrachtungen über neuere geometrische Forschungen (Erlanger Programm)
klein-1872.note: Unifies Euclidean, projective, and non-Euclidean geometries as invariant theories of transformation groups (codex in geometor/klein).

casey-1888.author: John Casey
casey-1888.work: A Sequel to the First Six Books of the Elements of Euclid
casey-1888.publisher: Hodges, Figgis, & Co., Dublin / Longmans, Green, & Co., London
casey-1888.note: Synthetic theory of coaxial circles, inversion, and orthogonal circles underpinning Euclidean constructions in the Poincaré disk (codex in geometor/casey).

lemoine-1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1902.work: Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine-1902.note: Quantitative complexity calculus of ruler-and-compass and circle-inversion constructions (codex in geometor/lemoine).

euclid-heath-1908.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas Little Heath)
euclid-heath-1908.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid-heath-1908.locus: 3 vols. (esp. Vol. I, Postulate 5 & Props. I.1–I.32)
euclid-heath-1908.note: Definitive commentary on the parallel postulate and Book VI circle-similarity theorems (folio codex in geometor/euclid and constructive DAG in geometor/elements).

wildberger-2005.author: Norman J. Wildberger
wildberger-2005.work: Divine Proportions: Rational Trigonometry to Universal Geometry (and Universal Hyperbolic Geometry I–IV, Geometriae Dedicata, 2010–2013)
wildberger-2005.note: Algebraic formulation of Euclidean and hyperbolic geometry via rational quadrance and spread without transcendental functions (formalized in geometor/wildberger).
